files.content:
Version_Registry:
  versions:
    - id: FO4_OG
      game: Fallout4
      version: "1.10.163"
      short_name: Fixture Standard
      display_name: Fixture Standard Edition
      docs_name: Fallout4
      steam_id: 12345
      is_vr: false
      priority: 20
      exe_hash: fixture-exe-hash
      address_library:
        filename: fixture-address.bin
        format: bin
        nexus_url: https://example.invalid/address
      xse:
        acronym: F4SE
        full_name: Fixture Extender
        compatible_version: "0.6.23"
        loader: fixture_loader.exe
        file_count: 1
        script_hashes:
          Fixture.pex: fixture-script-hash
      crashgen_versions:
        - version: "1.2.3"
          name: Fixture Crashgen
          acronym: FCG
          dll_file: fixture.dll
          description: Fixture diagnostics
          download_url: https://example.invalid/crashgen
    - id: FO4_VR
      game: Fallout4
      version: "1.2.72.0"
      short_name: Fixture VR
      display_name: Fixture VR Edition
      docs_name: FixtureVRDocs
      steam_id: 54321
      is_vr: true
      priority: 10
      xse:
        acronym: F4SEVR
        full_name: Fixture VR Extender
        compatible_version: "0.6.23"
        loader: f4sevr_loader.exe
        file_count: 0
        script_hashes: {}
  unknown_version_handling:
    strategy: nearest_match
    log_level: warning
    defaults:
      Fallout4: FO4_OG
